chapter.verse: Pasian aw, hong hon in! Bang hang hiam cih leh tui in ka ngawng ciang hong tum ta hi.
Khe tawh din’ kip nading mun a om lohna buannawng thuk sungah ka tum a, tuithuk sung ka tung khin a, ka tungah tuikhang luang hi.
Ka kiko-kona-in ka gim a, ka gawlgui keu ta hi. Ka Pasian ka ngakna-in ka mitte maang ta hi.
Thu omlopi-a kei hong mudah mi, ka lu tunga samzangte sangin tamzaw uh hi; kei hong susia ding, zuauthu tawh hong dote hat mahmah uh hi. Kei’ guk lohpi, ke’n loh ding ka hi hiam?
Pasian aw, ka pillohna na thei a, ka tatkhialhnate nangma kiang pan kiliah lo hi.
Vanglianpen Topa Pasian aw, nangmah hong muangte keima hangin zahhuaisak kei in; Israel Pasian aw, nang hong zongte keima hangin mindaisak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma hangin kona ka thuak a, maizumna in ka maitang hong tuam khin hi.
Ka sanggamte lakah midang ka suak khin a, ka innkuanpihte lakah khualmi ka suak hi.
Nangma inn ka deih luatna mei bangin ka sungah sa a, nangmah hong kote’ konate keima tung hong tu hi.
An ngolhna tawh ka lungsim ka kiniamkhiat ciangin, keimah hong kikona suak zawsop hi.
Ka puan dingin puanhampi bawl taleng zong amau adingin gentehna ka suak veve hi.
Khua kongpi sung a tu mite’ gengen ka hi a, zukhamte in keimah la-in hong sa uh hi.
Topa aw, kei ka hih leh nangma tungah thu kong ngetna in, a kicing na itna kip tawh a hun hoih ciangin hong dawng in, Pasian aw.
Buannawng sunga tum nading panin nangma thuman huhna tawh kei hong hon in la, tui thukte leh ka galte kiang panin hong suakta sak in.
Ka tungah tuikhang hong luangsak kei in la, khuamial thukpi hong nawmvalh sak kei in la, guum in a kuavang ka tungah hong khak nelhsak kei in.
Topa aw, na itna kip hoih manin kei hong dawng in la, na hehpihna lian a om tawh kizui-in kei lam hong nga in.
Na nasempa kiang pan na maitang seel kei in la, kei cimawh ka hih ciangin hong dawng meng in.
Kei kiangah hong nai in la hong tan in, ka galte’ hangin kei hong khah in!
Keimah hong kisimmawhna, ka maizumna leh ka mindaina nang na thei a, ka galte khempeuh nang na thei hi.
Simmawhna in ka lungsim sukham zo ahih manin kei ka cimawh hi. Hong hehpih ding ka zon’ hangin kuamah om lo hi; hong huh ding ka zon’ hangin kuamah ka mu kei hi.
Amaute in an dingin gu hong pia uh a, ka dangtakna-ah dawn dingin tuithuk hong pia uh hi.
Amau mai-a a sabuai uh thangzak suaksak in la, amau biakna pawite tehlop suaksak in.
Khua a muh theih loh nadingun amau mit mialsak in la, amau kawngte uh linglingsak in.
Amau tungah nangma thangpaihna sungsuk in la, na hehna so amaute bansak in.
Amau phualpi a kilawi mun suak hen la, amau buk-ah khat zong teengsak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in na satgawp mi amaute in bawlsia uh a, nangmah in na liamsaksa mi amaute in gimsak sawnsawn uh hi.
Amau dan thuakna ban-ah dan thuaksak thuahthuah in la, nangma tung panin suahtakna ngah kei ta uh hen.
A nungtate’ laibu sung panin amaute kiphiatsak in la, miphate lakah a min uh kikhumsak kei in.
Ahih hangin kei in gimna thuakin na ka sa hi; Pasian aw, na hotkhiatna in keimah a sangna munah hong koih ta hen!
La tawh Pasian min ka phat ding a, lungdamna tawh amah ka pahtawi ding hi.
Hih banga hihna in bawngtal khat ahi a, a ki leh a khecinte tawh a kim bawngtalno khat tawh sangin ahi zongin Topa lungdam sakzaw ding hi.
Nen’niamna a thuakte hih musak un la lungdam hen; Pasian a zong note aw, na lungsim uh nosuak sak kik un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a cimawhte’ aw za a, henna sunga om ama mite simmawh lo hi.
Vantung leh leitung, tuipi leh a sunga gamtang khempeuhte in amah phat ta uh hen.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in Zion hon-in Judah khuapite lamkik ding a, ama nasemte tua lai-ah teengin tang pah ding uh hi;
ama nasemte’ tate in tua leitang luah-in, amah a itte tua sungah teeng ding uh hi.
